phase_name: Authority Evaluation Model Contract Independent Verification
summary: Phase 147C independently verified AEM-001 v1.0 (Phase 147B's frozen Authority Evaluation Model Contract). Reconstructed the authority-evaluation problem (C-1) directly from IWC-001, IWPC-001 (Sec.4.1, Sec.18, Sec.29 item C-1, Sec.31), PEC-001 (Sec.20.2, PEC-REQ-111-117), CHGR-001 (Sec.6, Sec.11, Sec.20, Sec.20.5, Sec.21, Sec.26.3, CHGR-REQ-096/097/198-200), TAMC-001/TAMPC-001, and GAC-001 Sec.9 primary text and direct source inspection of src/pcae/interactive_workflow/models/session.py, publication_handoff/handoff.py, and src/pcae/governance/publication/record.py, deliberately before reading AEM-001 itself. The independent reconstruction agrees materially with AEM-001: C-1's existence and three-contract provenance, the absence of any eligible_authority evaluation mechanism or DecisionTemplate class anywhere in src/pcae, Session.template_ref's bare-opaque-str status, the structural unrelatedness of TAMC-001/TAMPC-001's CLTR authority_epoch/authority_state concept and GAC-001 Sec.9's governance-adoption decision, and the disclosure-only (never gating) judgment were all independently re-derived from primary text and match AEM-001's own conclusions. Independently re-derived that disclosure-only is required, not merely preferable, under IWPC-REQ-002/003's unconditional prohibition on this contract family inventing an authority-evaluation policy and PEC-REQ-115's existing 'MAY construct... never independent judgment of validity' discipline -- gating would require exactly the judgment PEC-REQ-115 already forbids, and IWPC-001 Sec.31 extends its prohibition to any successor addressing C-1 without its own fresh, explicit, higher-ceremony reasoning. Found two Non-Blocking findings, both disclosed in the report rather than silently resolved: F-147C-1, AEM-001's claim that no eligible_authority mechanism 'of any kind' exists anywhere in the repository is factually overbroad -- a required, free-text eligible_authority field (type string, minLength 1, maxLength 500) already exists in src/pcae/schema_resources/chgr/records/decision_template.schema.json since Phase 143E, unconsumed by any code path, in a shape incompatible with AEM-REQ-007's frozenset[str]-based EligibleAuthorityDeclaration, and omitted from AEM-001's own D-2 Conflict and Findings Register entry; assessed as Non-Blocking because the schema field is dormant (no DecisionTemplate class, store, or authoring workflow exists to consume it) and CHGR-001 Sec.6 itself mandates no particular data shape for a template's eligible-authority text, so no governing contract's normative text is contradicted -- recommended as a named input to Phase 147D rather than a blocker. F-147C-2, a cosmetic citation-precision defect: AEM-001's identity block cites IWC-001 Sec.11 as 'Human Responsibility Contract,' but that title belongs to IWC-001 Sec.6 (Sec.11 is 'State Contract'); the substance of both citations is otherwise used correctly. Zero Blocking findings. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. Full detail in docs/PHASE_147C_AUTHORITY_EVALUATION_MODEL_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
